study type: prospective randomized, double arm, single-blind, controlled study
cohort: 50 adult patients scheduled for abdominal surgeries under general anesthesia
finding: The addition of Tramadol to epidural Ropivacaine improved postoperative analgesic efficacy by prolonging the duration of analgesia and providing good sedation without significant hemodynamic alterations, nausea, vomiting, or pruritus.
